*data*

Unused old table of 4 words: $e640, $3600, $4500, $5400. These are unpacked scene bitmaps of $f00 bytes; scene 0 sat at its screen place.

<a id="old_scene_colour_ptrs"></a>
### [`old_scene_colour_ptrs`](../../../src/entry_and_tables.asm#L76) `$1289-$1290`

*data*

Unused table of 4 words: the v1 colour maps at $6300-$6a7f. v2 packs the maps at $68cb, so nothing reads this table now.

<a id="ai_move_substitute"></a>
### [`ai_move_substitute`](../../../src/entry_and_tables.asm#L102) `$12D0-$12E8`

*data*

AI attack substitution by move $00-$18, read at $26b4 when the opponent is in move $04, $07, $0a or $10. High attacks become low ones: $06, $0d and $18 become $0b; $07, $0c, $0e and $11 become $0a; $0f becomes $10.

- **Referred to by:** [`ai_substitute_move`](ai_opponent.md#ai_substitute_move) [`$26B4`](../../../src/ai_opponent.asm#L602)
